field.label: Enabled
field.help: Disabled rules are kept but not included in the generated config.

field.label: Instance
field.help: The xray instance this rule applies to.

field.label: Name
field.help: Optional description for the rules grid.

field.label: Match
field.help: What to match on. domain — plain/keyword:/regexp:/full: patterns. ip — CIDR list. port / sourcePort — numbers and ranges like 80,443,1000-2000. network — tcp, udp or tcp,udp. inboundTag — traffic of a specific inbound (tun-in, socks-in, vless-in). geoip / geosite — lists from geoip.dat / geosite.dat (files are installed by install.sh into /usr/local/etc/xray-core/). protocol — sniffed protocol: http, tls, bittorrent, quic.

field.label: Value
field.help: Comma-separated values. For geoip/geosite the geoip:/geosite: prefix is added automatically if omitted.

field.label: Network (AND)
field.help: Optional additional condition — embedded into the SAME xray rule (logical AND). E.g. geosite:category-ru + tcp,udp exactly like a hand-written config. Leave empty to match any network.

field.label: Source CIDR (AND)
field.help: Optional additional condition — source IP/CIDR list (comma-separated), embedded into the same rule. E.g. 192.168.1.0/24,10.0.0.5.

field.label: Action
field.help: proxy — the upstream node (or balancer when enabled). balancer — the balancer only (requires Load Balancing). direct — bypass via freedom. block — blackhole.
